headline: SLIPKNOT 🦹 Fans 😡 HIT 💥 BACK at MARILYN 🧛 MANSON Support 🎤 GIG 📍
text:
SLIPKNOT 🦹 just DROPPED 💣 a WORLD 🌍 tour 🚌 announcement and MARILYN 🧛 MANSON the 57-year-old 🧓 US 🇺🇸 rocker 🎸 is tagged 🏷️ on as support act 🎟️ for their massive Wembley 🏟️ Stadium show in London 🏙️ plus a bunch of South American 🇧🇷 dates too 🗓️!! The eight-piece 🤘 mask-wearing 🐷 crew will share the stage 🎤 with him and metalcore warriors Hatebreed 🐶 during those specific legs of the journey 🛫!! Some longtime fans are straight-up LIVID 😤 saying they will boycott 🚫 the whole thing over those past sexual abuse accusations 🕵️ against Manson 🧛 who has always strongly denied every single claim 🛡️!!

Thousands of replies flooded the official Instagram 📸 post that listed the full London lineup 🎫 and while a few were hyped 🚀 about the overlap of fanbases many called it a massive disappointment 😞 with comments like this is such a letdown 🥀!! Longtime Slipknot stans declared they would not buy tickets 🎟️ in protest refusing to put any cash 💰 into Manson's pockets ever again after the Evan Rachel Wood drama 🎥!! One fan posted "Would've loved to see this but there's literally nothing you could do to get my cash in Manson's pockets" while another added the announcement was "such a disappointment" and they would not be attending the show at all 🚫!!

However other voices pushed back hard arguing the two acts have a huge fanbase overlap and Manson 🧛 is actually a perfect support act for the masked maestros 🐷!! They pointed out the shared history and sonic synergy between the groups saying it makes total sense for the bill 📋!! Manson real name Brian Warner has always strongly denied any allegations insisting his intimate relationships were entirely consensual from the start ❤️!! The accusations first blew up when actress Evan Rachel Wood came forward in 2021 claiming he horrifically abused and manipulated her during their three-year relationship from 2007 🗣️!!

Several other women then shared similar stories on social media at the time which led to a 2022 documentary series called Phoenix Rising that focused on her allegations 🎞️!! Manson 🧛 sued Wood and another woman for defamation accusing them of impersonating FBI agents and forging federal documents 📜 but a judge dismissed some claims and he eventually settled the case agreeing to pay Wood's legal fees in 2024 ⚖️!! Last year prosecutors in Los Angeles announced they would not bring criminal charges after a four-year investigation into accusations of domestic abuse and sexual assault involving multiple women 🚔!! The district attorney's office stated the domestic abuse charges fell outside of the statute of limitations and they could not prove charges of sexual assault beyond a reasonable doubt 🧾!!

BBC Newsbeat reached out to Marilyn Manson's representatives and gig promoters Live Nation UK for comment but no response has dropped yet 📞!! The whole situation has the metal community split right down the middle with some ready to mosh 🕺 while others are sitting this one out in protest ✊!! Slipknot fans are hitting back hard at the support act reveal and the drama 🌀 is still unfolding even as the tour dates get closer 🗓️!!
